newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico peso mixed, dealers buy back dollars.
newsitem.headline: Mexico peso mixed, dealers buy back dollars.

text.p: The Mexican peso stood mixed at mid-morning trade on Tuesday after dealers had taken advantage of early firmness to buy back dollars, dealers said.
"There were no dollars in the market, dealers went a little short when the peso traded at less than 7.9350 per dollar, and now they are buying back dollars," a trader said.
The benchmark 48-hour peso and its 24-hour counterpart stood 0.1 and 0.3 of a centavo firmer, respectively, at 7.9405/7.9440 and 7.9385/7.9420 per dollar.
Same-day peso contracts had meanwhile closed trade for the day 3.6 centavos firmer at 7.9330/7.9380 per dollar.
